# Source: Ravinia Park Casino Building: Window

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** Ravinia Park Casino Building: Window
- **Artist / culture:** Peter Joseph Weber American, born Germany, 1864-1923
- **Date:** 1904 (building demolished in 1986)
- **Style:** Prairie School
- **Classification:** stained glass/leaded glass
- **Department:** Architecture and Design
- **AIC artwork ID:** 105278
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/105278
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/8069bcfd-52a1-a0db-cf4c-86d93d3766ba/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Prairie School

## Extracted source palette

`#181818, #C8D8D8, #88C8C8, #B8B8B8, #98A898, #68B8C8, #284848, #689898`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#0C0C0C`
- `surface`: `#282828`
- `on_surface`: `#F8F8F6`
- `primary`: `#68B8C8`
- `on_primary`: `#0C0C0E`
- `secondary`: `#284848`
- `surface_variant`: `#282828`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#F8F8F6`
- `outline`: `#4E4E4E`
- `error`: `#68B8C8`
- `on_error`: `#0C0C0E`

- Font: `inter` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `2dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `18.4:1`, surface `13.86:1`
- Variant contrast: `13.86:1`
- Control contrast: `8.63:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
